_comment: The budgets the size checks report against: skills/audit/scripts/fleet_check.py measures testCount, testSeconds, docWords and skillWords, and olivercode health measures contextWords and memoryWords. testCount is the number of tests, testSeconds the wall time of every tests/test_*.py module run in parallel, docWords the tracked markdown outside skills/, skillWords the tracked markdown under skills/, contextWords the always-loaded files and memoryWords the memory files. The three modules that start real git repositories (test_gate_secrets, test_owner_identifiers, test_size_ratchet) set most of the runtime. Raise a number only with the story that needs the room. testSeconds is 600 by the owner's decision on #294 until #313 brings the suite back to 60.
